QuestInfo.name: Alfonse Green's Herbs 1
QuestInfo.0: #bAlfonse Green#k in #bOrbis Cloud Park 1#k needs something...
QuestInfo.1: Alfonse Green wants Lavender Seeds to grow and make tea with. You can gather Lavender Seeds from Magenta Herbs...or off the market, if you're not an Herbalist.\n\n#i4022002##t4022002#  #b#c4022002# / 10#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave Lavender Seeds to Alfonse Green.

0.0: Ah, there's so much great food, so many great drinks! I love herb teas especially. Hmm, maybe you can help me out?\r\n
0.1: Ah, fantastic! Do you know where I can find some Lavender Seeds? I want to grow some Lavender to make tea with, but I can't seem to find any seeds! I've heard you can find them while #bharvesting herbs#k.
0.2: I hear you can get Lavender Seed from #bMagenta Herbs#k! I tried to get it, but I suppose I'm just not an Herbalist. Would you please go get #b10 Lavender Seeds#k? Thank you!

yes.0: You can get Lavender Seeds from Magenta Herbs! If you don't have #bHerbalism skill#k, maybe you can buy some off an Herbalist?

no.0: Oh, that's too bad. Now how will I make delicious lavender tea?

1.0: Woo-hoo! Lavendar Seeds! Oh, I'll have the grandest lavendar garden in all the land! Thank you so very much!

item.0: Still looking for #bLavender Seeds#k? Ah, if you're not an Herbalist, maybe one of your friends are?
